punctuation_registry.。: Period: Marks the end of a sentence.
punctuation_registry.、: Comma: Separates elements within a sentence.
punctuation_registry.・: Middle Dot: Used to separate items in a list or compound words.
punctuation_registry.—: Em Dash: Indicates a break in thought or a pause.
punctuation_registry.―: Horizontal Bar: Similar to '—', used for emphasis or interruption.
punctuation_registry.！: Exclamation Mark: Indicates exclamation or strong emotion.
punctuation_registry.〜: Tilde: Indicates a range or approximation.
punctuation_registry.…: Ellipsis: Indicates an ellipsis, showing omission or trailing off.
punctuation_registry.「: Opening Bracket: Used for quotations or emphasis.
punctuation_registry.」: Closing Bracket: Used for quotations or emphasis.
punctuation_registry.『: Opening Double Bracket: Used for quotes within quotes or titles.
punctuation_registry.』: Closing Double Bracket: Used for quotes within quotes or titles.

contraction_map.ちゃう: [Regret / Completion] Contraction of てしまう. (Note: In Kansai, can mean 'wrong').
contraction_map.じゃう: [Regret / Completion (Casual)] Contraction of でしまう. Indicates a completed action.
contraction_map.ちまう: [Regret / Completion (Rough)] Contraction of てしまう. Often used in rough speech.
contraction_map.とく: [Preparatory Action (Casual)] Contraction of ておく. Action done in advance.
contraction_map.どく: [Preparatory Action (Casual)] Contraction of でおく. Action done in advance.
contraction_map.といて: [Preparatory Action (Request)] Contraction of ておいて. 'Do this in advance.'
contraction_map.てる: [Continuous / State (Casual)] Contraction of ている. Indicates an ongoing action.
contraction_map.でる: [Continuous / State (Casual)] Contraction of でいる. Indicates an ongoing action.
contraction_map.てく: [Direction / Future (Casual)] Contraction of ていく. Action continuing into the future.
contraction_map.なきゃ: [Obligation (Casual)] Contraction of なければ. Means 'must do'.
contraction_map.なくちゃ: [Obligation (Casual)] Contraction of なくては. Means 'must do'.
contraction_map.じゃん: [Assertion (Casual)] Contraction of ではないか. Means 'isn't it?' or 'see?'.
contraction_map.かな: [Conjecture / Doubt] Sentence ender meaning 'I wonder...' or 'Should I...'
contraction_map.っけ: [Recall / Confirmation] Sentence ender used to recall a past memory ('Did you say...?', 'What was it again?').
contraction_map.だろ: [Conjecture] Casual form of だろう. 'Probably' or 'Right?'.
contraction_map.かも: [Conjecture] Contraction of かもしれない. 'Maybe' or 'Possibly'.
contraction_map.っす: [Polite / Slang] Highly casual shortening of です. Used between peers.
contraction_map.めっちゃ: [Slang] Contraction of めちゃくちゃ. Means 'Insanely' or 'Very'.
contraction_map.ねん: [Explanatory (Kansai Dialect)] Equivalent to standard 'n da' (んだ).
contraction_map.せや: [Agreement (Kansai Dialect)] Equivalent to standard 'sou da'. 'That is so'.

気: to feel like / have a hunch

顔: to show up / make an appearance
